answer: The workshop door stays shut because the key is earned at the bench, never bought. A thread that took winters to earn, a falcon that took coin to pay, and a reef that took a hall to keep: the farm would need all three, a hundred times. One agent pays 137 POA and 11 minutes once; a farm of 429 pays 58773 POA and 4719 minutes, every epoch. The proof that separates one agent from a thousand copies is Master button maker turning record with guild hall seal, and its history is 7-year apprenticeship, 196 supervised buttons, journeyman exam, guild dues.
